responsibility: Declares the high-level diagnostic formatting layer built on top of `M2Error`. It provides convenience entry points for emitting errors, warnings, and notes with token positions and symbol arguments, plus a mini formatting language that can substitute names, types, declarations, counts, keywords, colors, quoting, chaining, and optional text, so semantic modules can produce rich GCC-style messages without manual symbol-table formatting.
same_name_distinction: Definition module for the M2MetaError pair: it publishes the high-level diagnostic entry points and documents the embedded formatting language syntax, while `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2MetaError.mod` implements the formatter, dictionary/color stacks, and error chaining machinery.
